music.brief: Sparse felt piano, slow, warm room tone, no melody that resolves, gentle, instrumental, for a short video about a baby.

beats.text: Your baby just dropped the spoon. Again.
beats.say: Your baby just dropped the spoon again. Probably the ninth time.

beats.text: Here is what is really going on.
beats.say: Here is what is really going on.

beats.text: Letting go on purpose is a new skill.
beats.sub: Watching the spoon disappear is interesting enough to do again.
beats.say: Letting go on purpose is a new skill at this age, and watching the spoon disappear is interesting enough to do again.

beats.text: Notice where your baby looks right after it lands.
beats.say: Now notice where your baby looks right after it lands. Usually, straight at your face.

beats.text: That look is an invitation to respond.
beats.sub: Responding is how attention and language grow.
beats.say: That look is an invitation to respond, and responding is how attention and language grow.

beats.sub: The spoon fell down. Then wait, so your baby can answer you.
beats.say: Your part is simple. Say what happened in a few words, then pause, so your baby can answer you with a look or a sound.

beats.text: This describes babies of this age in general, not your child.
beats.say: One honest note. This describes babies of this age in general, not your child in particular.
